```{r}
## PRELIMINARY TASK 2

# --- 1. Setup and Data Loading ---
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(textstem)
library(rvest)
library(qdapRegex)
library(stopwords)
library(tokenizers)
library(glmnet)
library(irlba) 
library(tidytext)

source("/Users/bahaarahuja/Desktop/module-2-claims-data-table-2/scripts/preprocessing.R")

load("/Users/bahaarahuja/Desktop/module-2-claims-data-table-2/data/claims-raw.RData")
load("/Users/bahaarahuja/Desktop/module-2-claims-data-table-2/data/claims-cleaned-headers.RData") # Contains dtm_header

# --- 2. Reproduce Unigram LPCR & Extract Log-Odds (FIX 1) ---

# FIX 1: Instead of loading a saved model, we must reproduce the exact 
# LPCR fit logic from Preliminary Task 1 (the Rmd file) to get the log-odds.
# In a real environment, you should load the teammate's saved model and data.
lpcr_components <- function(data_dtm, k_pcs = 50){
  # Setup train/test split (same as Prelim 1)
  split <- initial_split(data_dtm, prop = 0.8, strata = bclass)
  train <- training(split)
  test <- testing(split)
  
  # Separate covariates from response and filter non-varying columns
  x_train <- train %>%
    select(-.id, -bclass) %>%
    select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
    as.matrix()
  
  y_train <- train$bclass
  
  x_test <- test %>%
    select(-.id, -bclass) %>%
    select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
    as.matrix()
  
  # Perform PCA (same logic as Prelim 1)
  col_sds <- apply(x_train, 2, sd)
  PCA_cols <- which(col_sds > 0 & !is.na(col_sds))
  
  x_train_PCA <- x_train[, PCA_cols, drop = FALSE]
  x_test_PCA <- x_test[, PCA_cols, drop = FALSE]
  
  pca <- prcomp(x_train_PCA, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
  
  # Extract PCs based on variance or fixed k (using fixed k=50 for example)
  var_exp <- pca$sdev^2
  prop_var <- var_exp / sum(var_exp)
  cum_var <- cumsum(prop_var)
  k80 <- which(cum_var >= 0.80)[1]
  k <- min(max(k80, k_pcs), ncol(pca$x))
  
  train_pc <- pca$x[, 1:k, drop = FALSE]
  test_pc <- predict(pca, x_test_PCA)[, 1:k, drop = FALSE]
  
  # Prepare training data frame for LPCR
  train_df <- as_tibble(train_pc) %>%
    mutate(bclass = y_train)
  
  # Fit LPCR
  lpcr_fit <- glm(formula = bclass ~ ., family = "binomial", data = train_df)
  
  # Predict log-odds (type = "link") for BOTH train and test sets
  train_log_odds <- predict(lpcr_fit, train_df, type = "link")
  
  # Prepare test data frame for the two-stage prediction later
  test_df <- as_tibble(test_pc) %>%
    mutate(bclass = test$bclass, .id = test$.id) 
  test_log_odds <- predict(lpcr_fit, test_df, type = "link")
  
  return(list(
    train_data = train,
    test_data = test,
    train_log_odds = train_log_odds,
    test_log_odds = test_log_odds
  ))
}

# Run the LPCR replication on the augmented data (dtm_header)
unigram_results <- lpcr_components(dtm_header)

# Extract the necessary training/testing components and log-odds
train_unigram_base <- unigram_results$train_data
test_unigram_base <- unigram_results$test_data
train_log_odds <- unigram_results$train_log_odds
test_log_odds <- unigram_results$test_log_odds

# --- 3. Bigram DTM Generation (FIX 2, 3, 4) ---

# FIX 3: Since the text_clean column is not explicitly loaded, we must reconstruct it.
# We will use the claims_raw.RData and the parse_fn_header for consistency.
claims_text_df <- claims_raw %>%
  filter(str_detect(text_tmp, '<!')) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(text_clean = parse_fn_header(text_tmp)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(text_clean != "") %>%
  select(.id, bclass, text_clean) %>%
  mutate(bclass = factor(bclass, levels = levels(dtm_header$bclass))) # ensure factor levels match DTM

# Custom Bigram Tokenization Function (FIX 2 & 4)
nlp_bigram_fn <- function(claims_text_data) {
  # FIX 2: Tokenize without stopwords arg, then filter stopwords manually.
  # The full set of stopwords provided by 'stopwords' package:
  custom_stopwords <- tibble(token = stopwords::stopwords("en", source = "snowball"))
  
  # Generate tokens (bigrams)
  bigram_tokens <- claims_text_data %>%
    select(.id, bclass, text_clean) %>%
    unnest_tokens(
      output = token,
      input = text_clean,
      token = "ngrams",
      n = 2
    ) 

  # Filter bigrams where at least one word is a stop word.
  # We split the bigram into two unigrams to check against the stopwords list.
  bigram_tokens_clean <- bigram_tokens %>%
    separate_wider_delim(
        token, delim = " ", names = c("word1", "word2"), too_few = "debug"
    ) %>%
    filter(!word1 %in% custom_stopwords$token) %>% # Filter if word1 is a stopword
    filter(!word2 %in% custom_stopwords$token) %>% # Filter if word2 is a stopword
    unite(token, word1, word2, sep = " ") # Rejoin the bigram
  
  # FIX 4: Use raw counts (n) instead of TF-IDF
  dtm_bigram <- bigram_tokens_clean %>%
    count(.id, bclass, token, name = 'n') %>%
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = c('.id', 'bclass'),
      names_from = 'token',
      values_from = 'n', # Use raw count 'n'
      values_fill = 0
    )
  return(dtm_bigram)
}

dtm_bigram <- nlp_bigram_fn(claims_text_df)

# Match splits for bigram DTM
train_bigram_df <- semi_join(dtm_bigram, train_unigram_base, by = c(".id"))
test_bigram_df <- semi_join(dtm_bigram, test_unigram_base, by = c(".id"))

# --- 4. Bigram PCA and Final Model Preparation ---

# Isolate bigram features for PCA
x_train_bigram <- train_bigram_df %>%
  select(-.id, -bclass) %>%
  as.matrix()

x_test_bigram <- test_bigram_df %>%
  select(-.id, -bclass) %>%
  as.matrix()

# Remove non-varying columns from bigram features (reusing Prelim 1 logic)
col_sds_bi <- apply(x_train_bigram, 2, sd)
PCA_cols_bi <- which(col_sds_bi > 0 & !is.na(col_sds_bi))

x_train_PCA_bi <- x_train_bigram[, PCA_cols_bi, drop = FALSE]
x_test_PCA_bi <- x_test_bigram[, PCA_cols_bi, drop = FALSE]

# Perform PCA on bigram features (selecting 50 components as example)
k_bigram <- 50
pca_bigram <- prcomp(x_train_PCA_bi, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

# Calculate number of PCs
var_exp_bi <- pca_bigram$sdev^2
prop_var_bi <- var_exp_bi / sum(var_exp_bi)
cum_var_bi <- cumsum(prop_var_bi)
k80_bi <- which(cum_var_bi >= 0.80)[1]
k_bi <- min(max(k80_bi, k_bigram), ncol(pca_bigram$x))

train_pc_bi <- pca_bigram$x[, 1:k_bi, drop = FALSE]
test_pc_bi <- predict(pca_bigram, x_test_PCA_bi)[, 1:k_bi, drop = FALSE]

# Prepare two-stage training data
train_two_stage_df <- as_tibble(train_pc_bi) %>%
  mutate(
    log_odds_unigram = train_log_odds,
    bclass = train_unigram_base$bclass
  )

# Prepare two-stage testing data
test_two_stage_df <- as_tibble(test_pc_bi) %>%
  mutate(
    log_odds_unigram = test_log_odds,
    bclass = test_unigram_base$bclass
  )

# --- 5. Two-Stage Logistic Regression Model ---

two_stage_model <- glm(bclass ~ ., data = select(train_two_stage_df, -c(.id)), family = binomial)

# --- 6. Evaluation (FIX 5) ---

test_pred_prob <- predict(two_stage_model, newdata = test_two_stage_df, type = "response")
labels <- levels(test_two_stage_df$bclass)

# FIX 5: Use factor levels for prediction class
test_pred_class <- factor(
  if_else(test_pred_prob > 0.5, labels[2], labels[1]),
  levels = labels
)

test_results <- tibble(
  truth = test_two_stage_df$bclass,
  estimate = test_pred_class,
  probability = test_pred_prob
)

accuracy <- accuracy(test_results, truth, estimate)$.estimate
roc_auc <- roc_auc(test_results, truth, probability)$.estimate

# Print results
cat("********************************************************\n")
cat("Preliminary Task 2 Results (Two-Stage LPCR with Bigrams)\n")
cat("********************************************************\n")
cat(sprintf("Test Set Accuracy: %.4f\n", accuracy))
cat(sprintf("Test Set AUC: %.4f\n", roc_auc))
cat("\nCompare these metrics to your Preliminary 1 LPCR model accuracy (dtm_header) to see if bigrams added predictive value.\n")
```
